title.zh: 人数相同，压力为何不同？

fullTitle.zh: 为什么同样是 1v2，有时心跳拉满，有时却觉得“输不了”？
fullTitle.en: Why does one 1v2 feel intense while another feels already won?

summary.zh: 1vN 只是表面标签。真正的决策压力，来自未解决威胁、目标强制、空间同步威胁与低容错执行的共同收束。
summary.en: Player count alone does not explain pressure. Unresolved threats, objective-forced commitment, simultaneous angles and execution costs combine to constrain the next decision.
